recipe.purpose: Recipe and firing lines on the index card, set on the blue ruling.

label.purpose: Control group labels on the glaze and kiln cards.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: A button inverting to ink when pressed.

motion.value: 0.9s sine, pot sinks into the bucket and rises

motion.purpose: Opening the kiln: pots come up out of the dark.

components.name: Button
components.description: Card-coloured button with an ink border that inverts when pressed and is hatched when disabled.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1.5px solid #1e2a31; border-radius: 10px; background: #f4f5f2; color: #1e2a31; font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s ease-out, transform .12s ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #fff; } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { background: #1e2a31; color: #f4f5f2; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f55c0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { color: #87949b; border-color: #d6dcdf; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30,42,49,.08) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px), #e9ecea; cursor: default; }

components.name: Go Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen.
components.css: .ds-go { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #2f55c0; color: #fff; font: 600 16px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-go:hover { background: #2a4db0; } .ds-go:active { background: #23439c; } .ds-go:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f55c0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Recipe Card
components.description: An index card with a warm top rule; recipe lines rest on blue ruling.
components.html:
Celadon

Glaze: Clear base, Iron 1. Medium dip.Firing: Gas kiln, cone 10, starved of air.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 320px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: #fbfbf9; border: 1px solid #d6dcdf; border-top: 3px solid #e3a49c; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1e2a31; } .ds-card h3 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-lines { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 26px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 25px, #c9d7ea 25px 26px); } .ds-lines span { display: block; }

components.name: Oxide Row
components.description: One pass of oxide: a name and five pips from 0 to 4.
components.css: .ds-ox { width: 300px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr repeat(5, 34px); gap: 4px; align-items: center; font: 600 13.5px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1e2a31; } .ds-ox button { height: 34px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1.5px solid #d6dcdf; background: #fff; color: #50606a; font-weight: 700; } .ds-ox button.on { background: #1e2a31; border-color: #1e2a31; color: #f4f5f2; }

narrative.overview: Kiln & Glaze is a slate-grey pottery studio where the only saturated colour is fired glaze, beside a stack of index-card recipes.
keyCharacteristics: A live firing trace over the kiln
A pegboard of 36 test tiles, frosted until found

rules.name: Colour is glaze
rules.body: The interface stays slate, card and ink so every colour on screen is one the player fired.

rules.name: Cobalt is the action
rules.body: One cobalt button per screen, plus selection.

rules.name: Amber is heat
rules.body: Ember amber only for the kiln and its trace.

dos: Let glazes be the only colour
Write recipes as a potter would
donts: No fired colour before the kiln opens
